dogecoin.text:
Every hero needs a rival, and for Doge, that’s Shiba Inu. 

Born in 2020, it called itself the “Dogecoin killer.” 

No one took it seriously… until it turned $10 investments into Lambos. https://t.co/al1eTEqfDZ

In 2013, two pranksters created Dogecoin. 

No roadmap, no ambition—just a Shiba Inu logo and laughs. 

Fast forward, and it’s worth billions. How did a joke outpace some serious cryptos? Community magic. https://t.co/HOjvsMJsjf
